metadata.title: झारखंड में एकज़ॉटिक सब्जियों की खेती | Adivasi Farmers Growing Exotic Vegetables in Jharkhand
metadata.description:
A new experiment of Krishak Pathshala is showing promising results in the tribal areas of Jharkhand. In this unique model, farmers from 7–8 nearby villages come together to learn and practice modern techniques of agriculture collectively.

This community-based classroom goes beyond traditional farming. Tribal farmers are being trained in exotic vegetable cultivation, fisheries, horticulture, and animal husbandry, helping them diversify income and reduce dependency on a single crop.

Main Bhi Bharat takes you to one such Krishak Pathshala, where learning happens in the fields, experience is shared among farmers, and modern knowledge blends with traditional wisdom. This ground report shows how collective learning is slowly transforming agriculture and livelihoods in Jharkhand’s tribal regions.
